notes: Ordered is an interactive atlas of halftone and dithering, delivered as a static folder with no build step, no dependencies, no network requests and no image files. Features: a live dotted planet lit by pointer or arrow keys, with three screens and PNG export; a scroll-linked dune landscape that resolves from continuous tone into dots; a word-by-word statement; an Atlas Lab comparing threshold, Bayer 8x8, Floyd-Steinberg and Atkinson dithering, with copyable source and PNG export; a dot-gain step wedge with keyboard navigation; and a dated history timeline. All imagery is procedural and monochrome. The model identifier was not exposed to this run, so the slug is unknown-model. Limitations: the dithering kernels were unit-tested in Node and the production build was run, but the page was not exercised in a live browser in this environment; rendering of the system font stacks varies by platform; the planet and landscape may be heavy on low-end devices; the dot-gain model is a simple illustrative curve, not a measured press profile.
